name: msl
description: The Minimum Sufficient Language principle and its lightweight reporting kernel for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Write checkable reports readers can act on
interface.longDescription: Apply the Minimum Sufficient Language principle through a compact kernel that binds the reader, partitions facts from instrument detail, emits every claim in a checkable form, and stops when the reader can act.
defaultPrompt: Use $msl to write this update so the reader can act on it.
